The fix-up diff also includes substantial additional work beyond the four findings (CodeBlock headerBadge prop, a new shared TruncationBadge component, and driving the chat indicator from per-Thought fields instead of a per-execution API fetch) which was reviewed directly in full; it introduces no new security, public-API, data-loss, or build/runtime issue, so no new finding was raised and no confirmation-lens dispatch was needed. All four original blocking findings are now resolved or superseded.

finding_status.notes: WorkflowStateOutput.tsx no longer wraps the warning icon in a <Button>. headerActions was split into a plain expandButton (Expand only) and a new headerBadge slot on CodeBlock that renders <TruncationBadge>, which is a non-interactive <span data-tooltip-id/data-tooltip-content> — not in the tab order, not announced as a button. Verified CodeBlock.tsx renders headerBadge inside a plain <div> beside the title, not inside any Button/interactive wrapper.

The ChatAiMessage.tsx useEffect that fetched truncation state via workflowExecutionsStore.getWorkflowExecutionStateOutput (the code this finding targeted) was deleted entirely. Truncation is now read synchronously from thought.truncated / thought.finish_reason, which chatGeneration.ts's _handleThought and chatHelpers.ts's transformHistoryGroup already populate from the streamed/persisted Thought data. There is no longer an async effect in this component for this concern, so the race/cleanup concern no longer applies to any code path.

WorkflowStateOutput.tsx's effect now declares `let cancelled = false`, wraps the fetch in try/catch, gates every setState call on `!cancelled`, and returns `() => { cancelled = true }` from the effect — matching the recommended ContinueWithInputPopup pattern exactly.

ContinueWithInputPopup.test.tsx's mock now returns { output: 'Step output text', truncated: false, finish_reason: null } instead of a bare string, fixing the type-shape defect. During this check round a regression test was added — 'renders the fetched state output once it resolves', asserting screen.getByText('Step output text') via waitFor — closing the coverage gap the finding flagged. Ran `npx vitest run src/pages/workflows/details/states/__tests__/ContinueWithInputPopup.test.tsx --project unit`: 7/7 tests passed.
